dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Points only: a scatter of about sixty small solid ink dots #23281F (all the same size, about 4 px), spread over the whole excerpt, denser in one cluster left of center and sparser elsewhere, like surveyed spot points. No lines, no labels, no other shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
